title: Silver Evaluation
description: The routing decision for one evaluation unit. Rules decide first; a decision model (Jev) handles what the rules leave. Output is typed: a tier and a calibrated confidence, never free text.

tier.description: Scrutiny band (safety axis): TIER_0 = deterministic, no model (skip). TIER_1 = judgment. TIER_2 = highest scrutiny / fail-closed ceiling (IAM, state, low confidence).

score.description: Continuous difficulty/risk. Drives the model ladder: low -> cheap small model, high -> heavier model. The fail-closed ceiling forces score 1.

confidence.description: Calibrated probability the decision is correct. Below the threshold fails closed to the top of the ladder.

signals.description: Deterministic signals that drove the decision (evidence, not opinion).
